title: Stop /create-a-space and /themes asking the browser to fetch Google Fonts CSS that connect-src blocks

source.ref: SCAN-1032 audit run 2026-11-09 against a production build of main 247fa6a2c; /themes

detail: One CSP violation per page: Connecting to https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Barlow... is refused by connect-src (next.config.ts). Find the client fetch of the font stylesheet (a <link> would be style-src, so this is a fetch), then load it through the allowed route or self-host the face, rather than widening connect-src. Done when: node scripts/audit/route-family-audit.mjs --routes /themes reports no finding of this kind.

verify.evidence: OPEN. Re-run the audit on a production build and read report.md.
